component.name: Walkdown
component.summary: Find plant equipment on P&ID drawings by KKS code

description.p: Walkdown shows a power plant's piping and instrumentation drawings with every tag readable and searchable. Pick a KKS code to see what it means, where the equipment is, its photos, notes and the operating procedures that use it.
Changes are signed by each person's device and sync between devices on the same Wi-Fi, or through the plant's server, without a central service. The plant's data never leaves the plant's devices.

About Walkdown, in the header bar's menu: the version and the exact commit it was built from, with a link to that source; the licence; links to the project, to report a problem and to help; every third-party part the app ships with its licence; and the course photo credits. Its Troubleshooting page has the version and system details to copy for support.

Drawings are sharp and smooth on high-resolution screens; leaving a form with typed text asks first; Escape ends Mark a tag, link mode and Select tags the same way their buttons do; a second start of the app shows the open window; course text and photo floors fixed.
A fourth course, Instrumentation and control; an open form keeps what you typed when the panel refreshes, and a button press is no longer lost or misdirected.
Photo for all asks for the floor first; a selection can take codes from any drawing.

Valve types and links between drawings; a coverage dashboard; dark drawings; one photo, place or note for several tags; photos compressed in the background and never lost; draft descriptions; who took each photo; grouped approvals; a leaderboard.
A two-finger trackpad pinch no longer crashes the app; the drawing is sharp at every zoom.
